name: add_address
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: Add a new shipping address to the current user's account.

is_default.description: If True, set as the default shipping address.

properties.description: str: The new address_id.

name: add_payment_method
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: Add a new credit or debit card as a payment method.

card_number.description: Full card number; only the last 4 digits are stored.

properties.description: str: The new payment_method_id.

name: add_to_cart
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: Add a product to the current user's cart. If seller_id is not specified, the Buy Box seller is used. If the product has variations, variant_id should be specified.

variant_id.description: Specific variant (size/color). Required for products with variations.

seller_id.description: Specific seller to buy from. Defaults to Buy Box winner.

gift_wrap.description: Whether to gift-wrap this item. Defaults to False.

gift_message.description: Gift message to include (only if gift_wrap is True).

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: Updated cart object including all items and computed subtotal.

name: add_to_wishlist
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: Add a product to a wish list. If no wishlist_id is specified, the current user's default wish list is used (created automatically if it does not exist).

product_id.description: The product to add to the wish list.

wishlist_id.description: Target wish list. Defaults to the user's default list.

note.description: Personal note about why you want this item.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: Updated wish list object.

name: apply_coupon
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: Apply a coupon code to the current user's cart. Validates eligibility without consuming the coupon (consumption happens at place_order).

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]:

applied.description: Whether the coupon was successfully applied.

reason.description: "OK" or an error code such as COUPON_NOT_FOUND, COUPON_EXPIRED, MIN_ORDER_NOT_MET, PRODUCT_NOT_ELIGIBLE.

discount_preview.description: Estimated discount in cents (0 if not applied).

name: cancel_order
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: Cancel an order. Only orders in "processing" status can be canceled. Orders that have already shipped must go through the return process. The order must belong to the current user.

reason.description: Short description of why the order is being canceled.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: order_id (str), canceled (bool), reason (str — "OK" or "NOT_CANCELABLE").

name: get_cart
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: Retrieve the current state of the current user's cart with a freshly computed subtotal.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: Cart object including items (List), subtotal (int, cents), item_count (int).

name: get_order_details
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: Retrieve full details for an order. The order must belong to the current user.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: order_id (str), user_id (str), items (List[Dict]), status (str — one of: processing, shipped, out_for_delivery, delivered, canceled, returned), shipping_option (str), tracking_number (str | None), address_id (str), pricing (Dict), placed_at (str), estimated_delivery_days (List[int]).

name: get_product_details
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: Retrieve full details for a product including description, images, variations (size, color), and the Buy Box offer.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: product_id (str), name (str), brand (str), category (str), description (str), images (List[str]), rating (float), review_count (int), variations (List[Dict] — each with variant_id, attributes {size?, color?}, price (int, cents), in_stock (bool)), buy_box (Dict | None — seller_id, price, shipping_cost, condition).

name: get_product_offers
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: Retrieve all seller offers for a product (the "Other Sellers on Amazon" list).

product_id.description: The product to get offers for.

properties.description: List[Dict[str, Any]]: Seller offers, each with: seller_id (str), seller_name (str), price (int, cents), shipping_cost (int, cents), shipping_speed (str), is_buy_box (bool), in_stock (bool), condition (str — "new", "used", "refurbished").

name: get_reviews
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: Retrieve reviews for a product with optional filters.

product_id.description: The product to get reviews for.

min_rating.description: Only return reviews with this minimum rating.

verified_only.description: If True, only return verified-purchase reviews.

properties.description: List[Dict[str, Any]]: Reviews, each with: review_id (str), rating (int), title (str), body (str), user_id (str), verified_purchase (bool), created_at (str).

name: get_wishlist
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: Retrieve a wish list. If no wishlist_id is provided, returns the current user's default wish list.

wishlist_id.description: Specific wish list to retrieve. Defaults to the user's default list.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: Wish list object with: wishlist_id (str), name (str), items (List[Dict]), is_default (bool), is_public (bool).

name: list_addresses
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: List all shipping addresses saved to the current user's account.

properties.description: List[Dict[str, Any]]: Address objects, each with: address_id (str), name (str), street (str), city (str), state (str), zip (str), country (str), is_default (bool).

name: list_payment_methods
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: List all payment methods saved to the current user's account.

properties.description: List[Dict[str, Any]]: Payment method objects, each with: payment_method_id (str), type (str), last_four (str), is_default (bool).

name: place_order
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: Place an order from the current user's cart. Charges the payment method and creates an order record. The cart is emptied after a successful order.

properties.description: str: The new order_id. The order begins in "processing" status.

name: remove_from_cart
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: Remove an item from the cart.

variant_id.description: Variant identifier to match the correct cart item.

seller_id.description: Seller identifier to match the correct cart item.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: Updated cart object.

name: remove_from_wishlist
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: Remove a product from a wish list.

wishlist_id.description: Target wish list. Defaults to the user's default list.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: Updated wish list object.

name: request_return
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: Request a return for a specific product from a delivered order. The order must belong to the current user.

order_id.description: The order containing the item to return.

properties.description: str: The new return_id for tracking the return.

name: search_products
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: Search for products matching a text query with optional filters.

query.description: Free-text search matched against product name, brand, and description. Pass an empty string to match all.

category.description: Filter by product category, e.g. "electronics", "books", "clothing", "home", "grocery". None returns all categories.

min_price.description: Minimum Buy Box price in cents. None for no lower bound.

max_price.description: Maximum Buy Box price in cents. None for no upper bound.

min_rating.description: Minimum average star rating (e.g. 4.0). None for no filter.

properties.description: List[Dict[str, Any]]: Matching products, each with fields: product_id (str), name (str), brand (str), category (str), rating (float), review_count (int), buy_box_price (int | None, cents), has_variations (bool), prime_eligible (bool).

name: select_shipping_option
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: Select a shipping option for the current user's cart. The selected option applies to the entire order at checkout.

shipping_option.description: Shipping speed key. One of: "standard" - 5-8 business days ($5.99). "expedited" - 2-3 business days ($12.99). "prime_two_day" - 2 days (free, Prime only). "prime_one_day" - 1 day (free, Prime only). "prime_same_day" - Same day (free, Prime only).

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]:

selected.description: The shipping option that was set.

eta_days.description: Estimated delivery range in days [min, max].

name: track_shipment
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: Get tracking information for a shipped order. The order must belong to the current user.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: order_id (str), tracking_number (str), status (str), shipping_option (str), estimated_delivery_days (List[int]), events (List[Dict] — shipping event history).

name: update_cart_item
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: Update an item already in the cart. Items are identified by the combination of product_id, variant_id, and seller_id.

quantity.description: New quantity; must be >= 1. Use remove_from_cart() to delete an item.

variant_id.description: Variant identifier to match the correct cart item.

seller_id.description: Seller identifier to match the correct cart item.

properties.description: Dict[str, Any]: Updated cart object.

name: write_review
description: This tool belongs to the Amazon marketplace system, which allows users to search products from multiple sellers, manage carts and wish lists, select shipping options, place orders with optional gift wrapping, handle returns, and write product reviews. Tool description: Write a product review. A user can only write one review per product.

properties.description: str: The new review_id.
